title: Thank You for Your Enquiry | Boothdrop Entertainment
metaDescription: Thanks for getting in touch with Boothdrop Entertainment. We have received your photo booth enquiry and will reply with a quote within 24 hours. Call 07368 631 516.
h1: Thank You, We Have Your Enquiry
intro: Your message is on its way to our team. We reply to every enquiry within 24 hours, usually much sooner, with availability for your date and a clear quote.

sections.heading: What happens next
paragraphs: One of our team will check availability for your date and come back to you by email or phone with a quote and any questions about the venue. If your event is less than two weeks away, or you would like an answer today, call or WhatsApp us on 07368 631 516.
Once you are happy with the quote, an £80 deposit secures your date and the balance is due one month before the event. In the meantime, feel free to browse our booths and the areas we cover.
